description:
CHARGE is an open movie, made entirely with Blender. Get the production files, assets and exclusive making-of videos by joining Blender Studio at https://studio.blender.org/films/charge

--

In an energy-scarce dystopia, an old destitute man breaks into a battery factory but soon finds himself confronted by a deadly security droid and no way out.

Blender Studio is the creative part of the Blender HQ. A dedicated team of artists and developers challenge themselves with creative-technical targets to help Blender users and to drive Blender development forward. This happens in an open source production environment and by sharing everything they make in an open and free license.

Want to know more? Join the studio today and help the team to create & share. https://studio.blender.org/
